meta.note: Effectiveness depends on your specific industry. Meta works best for visual services and consumer-facing businesses.

linkedin.note: Effectiveness depends on your specific industry. LinkedIn works best for B2B services targeting professionals and decision-makers.

lsa.note: Local Services Ads availability depends on your specific industry. Check Google's LSA eligibility tool for your service type.

google.note: Best platform for charter bus. High-intent searches ('charter bus rental near me', 'wedding shuttle bus Philadelphia') drive immediate leads from groups actively planning travel. Exact-match and phrase-match keywords for event types perform best.

meta.note: Strong secondary platform. Weddings, sports tours, and ticketed group tours perform well with visual content on Instagram and Facebook. Best used for retargeting Google visitors and lookalike audiences. Facebook's older demographic (35+) aligns well with church trips and corporate decision-makers.

linkedin.note: Niche use case — recommended only for corporate shuttle and conference transportation. Target HR Directors, Operations Managers, and Event Planners at mid-to-large companies. High CPL but very high LTV on corporate contracts. Not recommended for consumer/event charter.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Google Local Services Ads is designed for home services (plumbing, HVAC, etc.) and does not support the charter bus/transportation category. Use Google Search Ads instead.

google.note: Strong for both B2B (wholesale, co-packing) and DTC (online store, catering). High-intent searches like "bulk sausage supplier" or "private label food manufacturer" convert well.

meta.note: Best platform for food brands. Visual content (recipe videos, production behind-the-scenes, product beauty shots) drives exceptional engagement. Ideal for DTC, catering, and food truck promotion.

linkedin.note: Good for B2B services only (private label, co-packing, grocery distribution). Target food brand founders, grocery buyers, and procurement directors. Not useful for consumer-facing sales.

lsa.note: Not available for food manufacturing. LSA is limited to home services and select local service categories.

google.note: Best platform. High-intent searches like "industrial rigging company near me", "millwright services", and "heavy machinery movers" convert well. B2B buyers actively search Google when they have a project.

meta.note: Limited value for primary lead gen — plant managers don't browse Facebook for rigging services. Can work for retargeting website visitors and brand awareness with project time-lapse videos.

linkedin.note: Strong for large-value projects. Target plant managers, VP of Operations, and facility directors by job title. Account-based marketing for known manufacturing companies. Best for plant relocations and ongoing millwright contracts.

lsa.note: Not available for industrial rigging/millwright services. LSA is limited to home services categories.

google.note: Best platform for MSPs. Business owners and IT managers actively search for managed IT when they have pain — downtime, security incidents, or outgrowing their current provider. High intent converts well.

meta.note: Useful for retargeting and local awareness. Pain-point content and testimonials from local businesses work. Lead gen forms with free network assessments can generate pipeline. Not as intent-driven as Google.

linkedin.note: Strong for targeting IT decision makers at mid-market companies. Best for cybersecurity, cloud migration, and managed IT contracts. Account-based marketing by company size and industry is highly effective.

lsa.note: Not available for managed IT services. LSA is limited to home services and select local service categories.

google.note: Best platform. Municipal and industrial clients actively search for well contractors, pump repair, and drilling services. High-intent searches with limited competition in most markets. Emergency pump failures drive urgent search demand.

meta.note: Limited value — water superintendents and industrial facility managers rarely browse social media for well contractors. Useful only for retargeting website visitors and brand awareness with project showcases.

linkedin.note: Strong for large municipal contracts. Target water superintendents, public works directors, and engineering firm project managers by job title. Case studies and thought leadership about water supply infrastructure drive engagement.

lsa.note: Not available for commercial/municipal well and pump services. LSA covers residential well service but not industrial-scale contractors.

google.note: Best platform. Developers, municipalities, and property owners actively search for commercial hardscape contractors, design-build firms, and site construction companies. Project-specific searches have strong intent.

meta.note: Useful for portfolio showcase and brand building. Before/after project photos, drone footage, and time-lapse videos drive engagement. Strongest for luxury residential hardscaping. Good for retargeting website visitors.

linkedin.note: Strong for large commercial and municipal projects. Target developers, city engineers, architects, and institutional facility directors. Case studies and project portfolios build credibility with decision makers.

lsa.note: Not available for commercial site construction. LSA is limited to residential home services categories.

google.note: Strong for B2B manufacturing. High-intent searches for custom parts, equipment, and machining services convert well. Long-tail keywords reduce CPL.

meta.note: Limited value for industrial manufacturing. Useful for retargeting and brand awareness with video content, but B2B buyers rarely source manufacturers on social media.

linkedin.note: Strong platform for B2B manufacturing. Target procurement managers, engineers, and operations directors. Account-based marketing and case study content drive qualified leads.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Industrial manufacturing is a B2B service and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Best platform for fire protection. High-intent searches from building owners, GCs, and facility managers needing sprinkler, alarm, and suppression services. Compliance deadlines drive urgency.

meta.note: Limited value. Fire protection is a B2B compliance-driven service with low social media appeal. Useful for retargeting only.

linkedin.note: Good for targeting facility managers, property managers, and GCs for larger commercial fire protection projects. Account-based marketing works for known commercial properties.

lsa.note: Limited LSA fit. Fire protection services may be eligible in some markets but most work is commercial/B2B.

google.note: Best platform. Emergency refrigeration repair searches convert immediately. Restaurant and grocery owners search Google first when equipment fails.

meta.note: Moderate value. Can target restaurant owners with maintenance plans and seasonal promotions. Retargeting website visitors is effective.

linkedin.note: Limited value for most commercial refrigeration work. Only useful for large chain accounts and cold storage facility contracts.

lsa.note: Moderate LSA fit. Commercial refrigeration repair may be eligible in some markets. Emergency service calls benefit from proximity targeting.

google.note: Best platform. Families search Google when they need headstones and memorials. High-intent, need-driven searches with moderate competition.

meta.note: Good for portfolio showcase and compassionate brand building. Custom memorial photos and pet memorial products drive engagement. Sensitive targeting required.

linkedin.note: Not recommended. Memorial services are consumer-facing emotional purchases — LinkedIn is not where families look for headstones.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Memorial and monument services are not an LSA-eligible category.

google.note: Good for private-sector marine and civil projects. Limited search volume but high intent. Niche long-tail keywords have low competition and high project values.

meta.note: Limited lead gen value. Use for brand awareness with project showcase content and retargeting only.

linkedin.note: Best platform for heavy civil. Target engineers, developers, DOT project managers, and GC executives. Account-based marketing and thought leadership drive high-value project leads.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Heavy civil and marine construction is B2B/government and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Good for B2B cold chain searches. Logistics managers search Google when sourcing new providers. Niche keywords have moderate competition.

meta.note: Limited value. Cold chain logistics is a B2B service with low social media appeal. Retargeting only.

linkedin.note: Best platform for cold chain. Target supply chain directors, logistics VPs, and procurement managers. Account-based marketing for food and pharma companies is highly effective.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Cold chain logistics is a B2B service and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Good for niche refractory searches. Very limited search volume but extremely high intent and project values. Long-tail keywords face minimal competition.

meta.note: Not recommended. Refractory is a highly specialized B2B industrial service with no social media appeal.

linkedin.note: Best social platform for refractory. Target plant managers and maintenance directors at heavy industry facilities. Technical thought leadership content builds credibility.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Refractory services are B2B industrial and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Best platform. High-volume seasonal searches for mulch, soil, stone, and delivery. Local intent is very strong. Spring peaks drive massive search volume.

meta.note: Strong for landscape supply. Visual seasonal campaigns and promotional offers drive orders. Suburban homeowner targeting is effective. Facebook Marketplace can supplement.

linkedin.note: Not recommended. Landscape supply is a consumer/retail service — LinkedIn is not where homeowners shop for mulch.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Landscape material sales are retail and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Best platform. High-volume local searches for window tinting, PPF, and wraps. Strong intent and quick decision cycles drive high conversion rates.

meta.note: Strong for tinting and wraps. Highly visual services with excellent social media appeal. Before/after content and enthusiast targeting drive strong engagement.

linkedin.note: Limited value. Only useful for commercial window film and fleet wrap programs targeting facility managers and fleet directors.

lsa.note: Limited LSA fit. Window tinting is not a standard LSA category. Auto services may capture some leads in certain markets.

google.note: Good for B2B precast searches. Engineers and GCs search Google when sourcing precast for active projects. Niche keywords have moderate competition.

meta.note: Limited value. Precast concrete is a B2B construction product with low social media appeal. Architectural precast has some visual potential.

linkedin.note: Strong for precast. Target engineers, architects, and GCs. Account-based marketing for known construction firms and DOT projects is effective.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Precast concrete manufacturing is B2B and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Good for B2B mailing services. Businesses search Google when sourcing presort, fulfillment, and direct mail providers. Moderate competition on relevant terms.

meta.note: Limited value. Mailing services are B2B with low social media appeal. Some potential for direct mail marketing content targeting small business owners.

linkedin.note: Good for targeting marketing directors and operations managers at companies with high-volume mail needs. Cost-savings and ROI messaging drives engagement.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Mailing and presort services are B2B and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Best platform. High-volume local searches for car audio, remote start, and vehicle electronics. Strong intent and quick decision cycles.

meta.note: Strong for auto electronics. Enthusiast community engagement, installation videos, and product showcases drive excellent social performance. Car audio is inherently shareable content.

linkedin.note: Not recommended. Auto electronics is a consumer enthusiast market — LinkedIn is not where car audio buyers shop.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Auto electronics and car audio are not standard LSA categories.

google.note: Good for medical device searches. Biomedical engineers and procurement teams search Google when sourcing equipment. Niche product keywords have moderate competition.

meta.note: Limited value. Medical devices are a B2B healthcare product with compliance-sensitive marketing requirements. Retargeting only.

linkedin.note: Best platform for medical devices. Target hospital administrators, biomedical engineers, and procurement directors. Product launches, clinical data, and thought leadership drive high-value leads.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Medical devices are B2B healthcare products and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Best platform. Safety and compliance searches are high-intent, often triggered by OSHA citations, incidents, or audit requirements. Urgency drives strong conversion.

meta.note: Limited value. Industrial safety is a B2B compliance service with low social media appeal. Some potential for safety training webinar promotions.

linkedin.note: Strong for safety consulting. Target EHS directors, safety managers, and plant managers. Regulatory content and incident prevention case studies build authority and generate leads.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Industrial safety consulting is a B2B service and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Good for specialty building product searches. Architects and GCs search Google when sourcing fire-rated doors, acoustic systems, and specialty products for active projects.

meta.note: Limited value. Specialty building products are B2B with low social media appeal. Acoustic and interior products have some visual potential.

linkedin.note: Strong for specialty building products. Target architects, specifiers, and GCs. Technical content, code compliance updates, and product launches drive specification requests.

lsa.note: Not recommended. Specialty building products are B2B and not LSA-eligible.

google.note: Can capture inbound demand for specific technical services but search volume is low. Best for branded and long-tail technical keyword campaigns. Lower priority than LinkedIn for this B2B vertical.

meta.note: Not recommended. Decision-makers (Plant Managers, Capital Projects VPs, Procurement teams) are not reachable through Meta advertising.

linkedin.note: Primary platform for this vertical. Target Operations Directors, Plant Managers, Engineering VPs, Procurement Managers, and EHS Directors at refineries, chemical plants, and midstream operators. ABM toward companies announcing capital projects is highly effective.

lsa.note: Not applicable. Google LSA does not support industrial engineering consulting.

google.note: Strong channel for warehousing. Businesses actively search 'commercial warehousing near me', '3PL warehouse [city]', 'pick and pack fulfillment service'. High intent — companies searching are evaluating vendors and ready to get quotes. Geographic targeting is key for a regional facility.

meta.note: Limited effectiveness. Warehousing is a B2B service and decision-makers (Supply Chain Managers, Operations Directors) are not typically reachable via Facebook/Instagram. Can work for retargeting website visitors but not recommended as a primary channel.

linkedin.note: Strong secondary channel. Target Supply Chain Managers, Operations Directors, Logistics VPs, and Procurement Managers at manufacturers, retailers, and importers. Lead Gen Forms for quote requests work well. Geographic + industry + seniority targeting reaches the right decision-makers.

lsa.note: Not applicable. Google Local Services Ads is designed for home services and does not support commercial warehousing or 3PL services.

google.note: Niche B2B — low search volume but very high intent. 'Oilfield machine shop Corpus Christi', 'wellhead component machining TX', 'API threading machine shop'. Buyers who search are serious RFQ prospects. Geographic targeting around South Texas oil & gas corridor (Corpus Christi, Eagle Ford, Permian Basin) is key.

meta.note: Not recommended. Oilfield equipment procurement is a B2B decision made by engineers and procurement managers — not reachable through Facebook/Instagram advertising.

linkedin.note: Strong channel for reaching procurement teams at major oilfield service companies. Target Procurement Managers, Equipment Engineers, and Supply Chain Directors at Halliburton, NOV, SLB, Baker Hughes, Weatherford, and regional operators. Known customer logos (NOV, Cameron, FMC) are powerful social proof in LinkedIn content.

lsa.note: Not applicable. Google LSA does not support industrial machining or oilfield services.

google.note: High-intent search drives most kitchen & bath remodel leads — homeowners actively searching 'kitchen remodel Nashville' are prime prospects. Google Search + Local Service Ads capture ready-to-hire traffic. Strongest platform for this industry.

meta.note: Instagram and Facebook are highly effective for visual remodeling services. Before/after content, project galleries, and Reels build brand desire and generate warm leads. Strong for nurturing and retargeting. Excellent for Hantel given showroom aesthetic.

linkedin.note: Residential remodeling audience is not on LinkedIn. Only relevant if pursuing commercial kitchen/bath contracts. Not recommended for typical Hantel residential clients.

lsa.note: Local Service Ads available under Home Improvement category. Google Guaranteed badge adds trust for in-home estimates. Cost-effective for 'kitchen remodeler near me' and 'bathroom remodel company Nashville' queries. Worth running alongside Search campaigns.

google.note: Google Search + Google Shopping are the primary drivers for retail fixture ecommerce. Buyers search specific product terms ('gondola shelving', 'glass display cases') with high purchase intent. Shopping campaigns are essential — product listing ads with images, price, and brand are the standard format for this category. Strongest platform by far.

meta.note: Meta works well for ecommerce retargeting (Dynamic Product Ads) and lookalike audiences built from purchaser lists. Instagram Shopping integration adds discovery value. Cold audiences for new store openings and retail entrepreneurs can be effective with video/lifestyle creative. Good complement to Google — not standalone.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn is niche for this industry — only worthwhile if targeting enterprise retail chains, franchise operators, or visual merchandising managers at large retailers. High CPL makes it inefficient for small independent retailer audience. Skip unless specifically pursuing multi-unit or corporate accounts.

lsa.note: Local Service Ads are not applicable for ecommerce businesses. LSA is designed for local service providers (HVAC, plumbing, etc.) and does not support retail product categories. Dawson Jones ships nationally — LSA is not relevant.

google.note: Auto glass is one of the highest-intent search categories — customers actively search when they have a cracked or damaged windshield and need service fast. Google Search + Local Pack dominate lead volume. 'Windshield replacement near me', 'windshield repair [city]', and 'rock chip repair' are high-conversion, high-volume terms. Primary platform by a wide margin.

meta.note: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) is a secondary awareness channel for auto glass. Works best for retargeting website visitors who didn't book and lookalike audiences for brand building. The 'insurance may cover it free' angle can generate engagement. Not a primary lead source — customers don't browse social media looking for windshield repair.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn is not relevant for consumer auto glass. Only worthwhile if specifically targeting fleet managers or corporate accounts for commercial vehicle glass programs. Skip for standard residential auto glass clients.

lsa.note: Local Service Ads (Google Guaranteed) are highly effective for auto glass — the trust badge is valuable for a service where customers hand over their vehicle. Auto glass is a supported LSA category. Pay-per-lead model works well since demand is spiky and predictable. Strong complement to Search campaigns, especially for mobile service positioning.

google.note: Google Search captures the highest-intent buyers — people searching 'granite countertops Houston' or 'marble flooring installer Houston TX' are actively ready to purchase. Dominant channel for all residential stone services. Google Shopping can also feature individual stone products for supply-only searches. Primary platform by a wide margin.

meta.note: Instagram and Facebook are excellent for natural stone — it's a highly visual, aspirational product category. Before/after photos, slab close-ups, and kitchen/bathroom reveals generate strong engagement and showroom visits. Retargeting website visitors with gallery content converts well. Instagram Reels showcasing stone fabrication or finished installs perform especially well.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn is relevant for Natural Stone Gallery's commercial and hospitality division — reaching hotel developers, architects, interior designers, and general contractors who spec stone for large projects. High CPL but commercial stone contracts ($20K–$150K+) have strong ROI. Skip for residential-only campaigns.

lsa.note: Google Local Service Ads have limited category support for stone fabricators. Available under Home Improvement, but stone fabrication is not a primary LSA category like plumbing or HVAC. Worth testing with a small budget but not a primary channel. Google Search + Meta should take priority.

google.note: Google Search is the dominant channel — contractors, builders, and homeowners search for dumpster rental, concrete slab quotes, fill dirt delivery, and site prep services with high intent. Local Pack visibility is critical in Tampa metro. Search campaigns with location targeting to Hillsboro/Pasco/Polk/Pinellas counties drive the most qualified leads.

meta.note: Meta is a secondary awareness channel. Works for before/after concrete project content targeting Tampa homeowners, and retargeting website visitors. Facebook life-event targeting (new homeowner, recent mover) reaches people planning site work. Not a primary channel — supplement Google Search for brand building and retargeting.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn is limited for dump truck/site services — the primary buyers (homeowners, residential contractors) are not on LinkedIn for procurement. Only useful if specifically targeting commercial developers, construction project managers, or property management firms for large-scale site work contracts. Skip for residential-focused campaigns.

lsa.note: Google Local Service Ads are available for dumpster rental under the Junk Removal/Hauling category. Google Guaranteed badge helps compete with national roll-off companies. Worth running for dumpster-specific campaigns alongside regular Search. LSA not available for concrete or excavation categories.

google.note: Google Search captures high-intent procurement searches — plant maintenance teams searching for 'conveyor belt repair Savannah' or '24/7 industrial conveyor service' are ready to call. Emergency service queries convert fast. Lower volume for niche products (loading arms) but strong for conveyor and rubber supply searches. Google call-only ads with 24/7 extensions are especially effective for the emergency service line.

meta.note: Facebook/Instagram is not effective for B2B industrial equipment and services. The decision-makers (plant managers, maintenance directors, procurement) are not shopping for conveyor belts or loading arms on social media. Only marginal use case: waterjet cutting videos can attract fabrication shop attention. Skip Meta and invest in Google + LinkedIn instead.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn is the primary outreach channel for this B2B industrial business. Plant managers, EHS directors, maintenance managers, procurement officers, and project engineers at pulp & paper mills, petrochemical facilities, and power plants are all on LinkedIn. Sponsored Content with technical case studies, InMail for targeted outreach, and company targeting of specific facilities in the Southeast all drive high-quality leads. Essential for loading arms and fall protection where search volume is near zero.

lsa.note: Google Local Service Ads are not available for B2B industrial equipment suppliers. LSA categories cover consumer-facing services (plumbing, HVAC, etc.), not industrial conveyor or rubber product supply. Not applicable.
